title: Learn Hip Hop Dance: Cabbage Patch

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor breaks down movements methodically from the feet up to the arms. He provides multiple variations of the step and pairs them with music demonstration.

lesson_structure.note: Instructor introduces himself and the Cabbage Patch move
Breaks down the footwork starting with the right foot
Adds arm movements and running image instruction
Teaches an alternative variation using hops

steps_taught.name: Cabbage Patch (Footwork)
steps_taught.description: Step and tap foot pattern starting with the right foot

steps_taught.name: Cabbage Patch (Arms)
steps_taught.description: Alternating arm pumping motion simulating running

what_works: Splits the lesson into feet first then arms
Provides split screen showing close up of feet

quotes.text: let's start with the feet and work our way up to the top
for your classically trained dancers that is the pot de bras
now let's do it with the music

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor demonstrates foot movement while split screen shows foot close-up
Instructor coordinates arm pumping action with step

extraction.distinctive_method: Uses split screen to simultaneously show a full body view and a close-up angle of the feet.
